# Avensoft Technologies

> Avensoft Technologies is an engineering studio architecting mission-critical software systems across India — from native Android applications and AI integrations to high-throughput cloud portals and public sector ERPs.

## Live Deployments & Proven Case Studies
All solutions built by Avensoft are tested in real operational environments:

1. **SISTec Digital Campus Pass (Live in Production)**
   - **Domain**: Education & Campus Administration
   - **Client/Location**: Sagar Group of Institutions (SISTec), Bhopal, MP
   - **Problem Solved**: Replaced a 30+ minute paper slip hostel outpass workflow involving multiple wardens with a tamper-proof QR code pass system.
   - **Key Metrics**: Gate verification scan time < 6 seconds, thousands of paper slips saved monthly, 100% timestamped audit trail, zero fraud incidents since launch.
   - **Live System URL**: https://deepakkumar7388.github.io/SISTec-Digital-Pass/
   - **Video Demonstration**: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NrBc7qjgI5Q
   - **Tech Stack**: Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, QR Authentication, PWA.

2. **CHC Koraon Hospital Management System (Live in Production)**
   - **Domain**: Public Health Informatics & OPD Management
   - **Client/Location**: Community Health Centre (CHC), Koraon, Prayagraj, Uttar Pradesh
   - **Problem Solved**: Eliminated 60+ minute queues for handwritten OPD slips with a 30-second digital patient registration workflow with bilingual receipts and doctor queue dashboards.
   - **Key Metrics**: ~40% faster queue processing, runs seamlessly on low-bandwidth 4G connections, zero lost paper records, daily reports for BMO & CMHO offices.
   - **Live System URL**: https://deepakkumar7388.github.io/Chaudhary_Health_Care-Center-Koraon-Pryagraj/
   - **Simulator Demo**: https://deepakkumar7388.github.io/CHC_Simulator/
   - **Tech Stack**: React, Node.js, MySQL, ESC/POS Thermal Printing, Offline Sync.

3. **DualShield AI — Road Safety Platform (Field Trial)**
   - **Domain**: Road Safety & On-Device Machine Learning
   - **Platform**: Native Android (Zero external hardware required)
   - **Features**: Real-time sensor-based crash/fall detection, automated emergency SOS calling with live GPS coordinates, and proactive speed-aware voice warnings when entering accident-prone High-Risk Zones.
   - **Tech Stack**: Android SDK, Kotlin, Sensor APIs, GPS Geofencing, Text-to-Speech, On-Device AI.

## Core Engineering Services
Avensoft Technologies offers end-to-end software development across six primary disciplines:

1. **Custom Web Development**
   - Full-stack web applications, custom enterprise portals, role-based dashboards, and scalable REST / GraphQL APIs.
   - Built for sub-300ms page load speeds and 99.9% uptime.
   - Frameworks: Next.js, React, Node.js, Spring Boot (Java), Django/FastAPI (Python), Laravel (PHP), Angular, Vue.js.

2. **Native & Cross-Platform Mobile Engineering**
   - High-performance mobile apps with 120fps fluid rendering, battery efficiency, and offline-first database synchronization.
   - Frameworks: Native Android (Kotlin & Jetpack Compose), iOS (Swift & SwiftUI), Flutter, React Native.

3. **Applied AI & Machine Learning**
   - Edge and cloud AI architectures without unnecessary latency.
   - Capabilities: Custom Generative AI & LLM Fine-tuning, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Autonomous AI Agents for enterprise workflow automation, NLP & Omnichannel AI Chatbots, Computer Vision (TensorFlow Lite, PyTorch Mobile, OpenCV).

4. **Institutional ERP & Enterprise Systems**
   - Secure multi-tenant SaaS platforms, role-governed data workflows, automated audit logs, and digital replacement for paper and spreadsheet bottlenecks.

5. **Product Design & UI/UX Research**
   - Human-centric UX research, accessible design systems (WCAG 2.2 AA compliant), wireframing, high-fidelity prototypes, and bilingual UI in Figma.

6. **Dedicated Engineering SLA & Maintenance**
   - Continuous 24/7 system health monitoring, automated encrypted daily backups, regular security patching, and direct developer hotline support.
